svg.title: The gap between North America and Sub-Saharan Africa narrowed only somewhat over 2005–2025
svg.desc: Line chart: The gap between North America and Sub-Saharan Africa narrowed only somewhat over 2005–2025: Gap: 66.3 in 2005, 71.7 in 2007, 67.6 in 2009, 63.5 in 2011, 61.6 in 2013, 59.9 in 2015, 67.8 in 2017, 65.3 in 2019, 62.5 in 2021, 61.0 in 2023, 59.9 in 2025.
